name: the server deletes every file of the account: the device holds the deletes, every local copy survives
description: DEGOO-001 (sync-chaos srv-account-never-deleted, client side): Degoo's cancelbot closed accounts and deleted every file, local copies were the only survivors. Rules D1 and D2: a remote that suddenly deletes everything is a mass delete, held for the user; nothing local is touched or trashed.

name: an abuse flag never deletes an account's data without a human review
description: DEGOO-001: the deletion itself is a server policy (rule V7): an abuse flag leads to read-only, notices, an audit log and a human review.
not_applicable: the account-deletion policy lives in the token server and iso, not in AzDrive; AzDrive's stand-in remote has no account. It is sync-chaos srv-account-never-deleted (dc mode, azctl test money)
